config.loss: mean per-position KL(target || drafter), full vocabulary, temperature 1
config.positions: all 256 prefixes per chunk; no padding, labels, chat template, or activation matching
config.checkpoint_selection: lowest KL on all 50 validation chunks, including phase-start weights
config.timing: synchronized wall time including prefill and all decode work; both drafters merged/plain

dataset_manifest.sampling: seeded shuffled articles, random-offset nonoverlapping gap tiling, randomized article-balanced rounds and final order
limitations: Excludes all known project and official WikiText evaluation data, not unknown external benchmarks.
128-bit passage fingerprints are conservative collision checks; matches are rejected.
No semantic/paraphrase or model-pretraining contamination guarantee.
Some training articles recur with new disjoint text; prior training chunks never recur.
